items.quote: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s handmaid, bare unto Abraham
items.claim: The text says Ishmael was Abraham's son, born to Hagar the Egyptian, who was Sarah's handmaid.

items.quote: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam, 25:14 And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa, 25:15 Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah
items.claim: The text lists Ishmael's sons as Nebajoth (the firstborn), Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadar, Tema, Jetur, Naphish and Kedemah.
items.object: Nebajoth, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadar, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, Kedemah

items.quote: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.
items.claim: The text presents Ishmael's twelve sons as princes of separate nations, each linked to towns and castles.
